name: flipbands
description: Dense grids on the bands where ideas/PRIORITIES.md expects the winner to flip (phase 3 refinement): warp N 256 k 8 to 64, N 512 k 16 to 64, N 1024 and 2048 at k 16 and 32, block N 1024 k 8 to 64, N 8192 and above at k 16 to 256. Same filters as cells_focus.json: a cell is one combination with k <= n/2 and n >= threads, k restricted per N by k_by_n below.
